ei.title: 신체 활동의 감소와 만성 질환의 연결

fullPassage: If we take an evolutionary look at our beginnings, we see a life in which high levels of physical activity were required for survival. Even one century ago, most people needed to be physically active to work, to travel, and to take care of homes and families. Our modern world has engineered such activity out of our lives. There are fewer manual jobs, we do not need to travel on foot, we do not need to hunt and harvest for our food, and many domestic chores have been mechanized. While these changes have created many benefits for our longevity and quality of life, they have also created many problems. Lack of sufficient physical activity has now been linked to at least unhealthy conditions, almost all of which are chronic diseases or are considered risk factors for chronic diseases. Adrianne Hardman has summarized this serious situation for public health: "Physical inactivity is a waste of human potential for health and well-being."

det.analysis:
✅ ① required: 수동태 were required 올바름.
❌ ② creating → created: have + p.p. 현재완료에서 과거분사 필요. ← 정답
✅ ③ considered: 수동태 are considered 올바름.
✅ ④ summarized: 현재완료 has summarized 올바름.
det.tip: have/has + p.p. (현재완료): have created

While these changes have created many benefits for our ①<u>mortality</u> and quality of life, they have also created many problems. det.korean: ① mortality → longevity: 이러한 변화가 '사망률'이 아니라 '수명/장수'에 혜택을 가져왔습니다.

❌ ① mortality → longevity: benefits for our longevity(장수에 대한 혜택). mortality(사망률)는 반대 의미. ← 정답

✅ ③ risk: '위험' 요인이라는 문맥 적절.
✅ ④ serious: '심각한' 상황이라는 문맥 적절.
det.tip: longevity(장수) ↔ mortality(사망률)

questions.passage: If we take an evolutionary look at our beginnings, we see a life in which high levels of physical activity were required for survival. det.korean: ③ activity → inactivity: 신체적 '활동'이 아니라 '비활동'이 인간 잠재력의 낭비입니다.

det.tip: inactivity(비활동) ↔ activity(활동)

questions.passage: If we take an evolutionary look at our beginnings, we see a life in which high levels of physical activity were required for survival. Even one century ago, most people needed to be physically active to work, to travel, and to take care of homes and families. Our modern world has engineered such activity out of our lives. There are fewer manual jobs, we do not need to travel on foot, we do not need to hunt and harvest for our food, and many domestic chores have been mechanized. While <u>these changes</u> have created many benefits for our longevity and quality of life, they have also created many problems. Lack of sufficient physical activity has now been linked to at least unhealthy conditions, almost all of which are chronic diseases or are considered risk factors for chronic diseases. Adrianne Hardman has summarized this serious situation for public health: "Physical inactivity is a waste of human potential for health and well-being."
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 these changes가 가리키는 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ④ 진화적 변화: 진화는 먼 과거의 이야기이고 these changes는 현대 변화.
❌ ② 만성 질환의 증가: 질환 증가는 결과이지 변화 자체가 아님.
